name: Heng Leasing and Capital Public Company Limited
summary: Based in San Sai, Thailand, Heng Leasing and Capital Public Company Limited delivers a comprehensive suite of financial services throughout the country. Since its inception in 2015, the firm has expanded its operations to 617 branches. Its offerings span hire purchase agreements, loans collateralized by vehicle registrations, real estate-backed financing for land and buildings, personal loans, and unsecured nano finance. Additionally, the company serves as a broker for both non-life and life insurance policies.
